officialName: Statement Regarding the Working of Patented Invention(s) on a Commercial Scale in India
purpose: The mandatory annual statement by which a patentee/licensee reports whether each patented invention has been worked in India in a given financial year, and (if not worked) the reasons, and whether the patent is available for licensing.

fee.note: No Fee — explicitly marked on the form face.

layout.notes: Two-column table with six numbered rows. Contains a worked/not-worked table, reason checkboxes, and licensing-availability options. One form may cover multiple patents only if they are related and granted to the same patentee(s).

sections.title: Patentee/Licensee and Patent Number(s)
sections.description: Pre-printed: 'I/We, the Patentee(s)/Licensee ......, in respect of patent number(s) ......, furnish this statement, (Explanation: One form may be filed in respect of multiple patents, provided all of them are related patents and are granted to the same patentee(s)).'

fields.label: Name, address and nationality
fields.helpText: Instruction 1: full name, complete address incl postal index no./code and state, and nationality.

validation.message: Enter the name, address and nationality.

fields.label: Patent number(s)
fields.helpText: Multiple patents may be covered only if they are related patents granted to the same patentee(s).

fields.text: , furnish this statement, (Explanation: One form may be filed in respect of multiple patents, provided all of them are related patents and are granted to the same patentee(s)).

sections.title: Financial Year
sections.description: State the financial year to which the statement relates.

fields.label: Financial year
fields.helpText: The financial year to which this statement relates.

validation.patternMessage: Enter the financial year as e.g. 2024-2025.

autofill.derivation: Default to the most recently completed financial year; editable.

sections.title: Worked / Not Worked
sections.description: One row per patent number covered by the statement. Per row, exactly one of Worked / Not worked should be ticked.

sections.title: If Not Worked, Reasons
sections.description: Complete when any patent above is marked 'Not worked'.

options.label: Patented Invention is under development/ commercial trial
Patented Invention is under Review/approval with Regulatory authorities

fields.label: Whether the patent is available for licensing

fields.text: If so, would you be interested in receiving communications from any person interested in seeking a license. If so, kindly provide contact details as below:

fields.text: The facts and matters stated above are true to the best of my/ our knowledge, information and belief.

autofill.derivation: Default to the preparation / signing date; editable.

autofill.derivation: Jurisdictional patent office based on the patentee's address or the office recorded on the patent.

notes: No Fee — explicitly marked on the form face; do not attach a fee step to this form.
Note. - Strike out whichever is not applicable (Patentee(s)/Licensee, my/our).
Form 27 must be filed for every financial year in which the patent was in force (Rule 131); non-filing carries penalties.
One form may cover several patents only if they are related and share the same patentee(s).

Per row of the working table, exactly one of 'Worked' / 'Not worked' should be ticked; a 'Not worked' row activates the reasons above. This per-row rule is stated here rather than as a machine constraint because the v1.0 condition language addresses fields, not individual table rows.
